# PicaComic attribution

Protocol and parsing adaptations in `lib/src/comics/sources/`, Hitomi search,
and JM image reconstruction in `lib/src/comics/comic_images.dart` are based on
[PicaComic](https://github.com/ccbkv/PicaComic), revision
`5ac06557fb3b7b99ed27715f70acd398f82dbaf3`.
